B.text: This chapter highlights trends in digital adoption and identifies remaining barriers to adoption, placing particular focus on low- and middle-income countries, where the lingering presence of well- known obstacles to adoption are the most profound. The chapter also analyzes how the COVID-19 pandemic has affected the patterns of internet use and examines how firms have adopted and invested in digital technologies.
